schema: index chat_conversation: CREATE INDEX chat_conversation ON chat (conversation_id, id)
index chat_questions: CREATE INDEX chat_questions ON chat (conversation_id) WHERE meta LIKE '%"kind":"question"%'
index conversations_updated: CREATE INDEX conversations_updated ON conversations (status, updated_at)
index events_kind_at: CREATE INDEX events_kind_at ON events (kind, at)
index events_task: CREATE INDEX events_task ON events (task_id, id)
index inbox_sections_person: CREATE INDEX inbox_sections_person ON inbox_sections (person_id, zone, position)
index messages_task: CREATE INDEX messages_task ON messages (task_id, id)
index messages_to: CREATE INDEX messages_to ON messages (to_agent, id)
index session_items_approval: CREATE INDEX session_items_approval ON session_items (id) WHERE kind = 'approval'
index session_items_session: CREATE INDEX session_items_session ON session_items (session_id, id)
index session_queue_session: CREATE INDEX session_queue_session ON session_queue (session_id, position, id)
index sessions_updated: CREATE INDEX sessions_updated ON sessions (archived, updated_at)
index tasks_conversation: CREATE INDEX tasks_conversation ON tasks (conversation_id)
index tasks_parent: CREATE INDEX tasks_parent ON tasks (parent_id)
index tasks_review: CREATE INDEX tasks_review ON tasks (review_of)
index tasks_status: CREATE INDEX tasks_status ON tasks (status, id)
index usage_day: CREATE INDEX usage_day ON usage_ledger (day, account_id, person_id, bot_id)
table chat: CREATE TABLE chat ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, role TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, meta TEXT, at TEXT NOT NULL , conversation_id INTEGER)

table conversations: CREATE TABLE conversations ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, titled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, project TEXT, agent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude', account TEXT, model TEXT, reasoning TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium', session_id TEXT, turns INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, context TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'done')), done_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL , bot_id INTEGER, group_id INTEGER)

table devices: CREATE TABLE devices ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen TEXT , public_key TEXT, route TEXT, push TEXT, kind TEXT, ip TEXT, meta TEXT)
table events: CREATE TABLE events ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, task_id INTEGER, actor TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT DEFAULT '', at TEXT NOT NULL )

table inbox_items: CREATE TABLE inbox_items ( person_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('bot', 'group', 'conversation', 'session')), item_id TEXT NOT NULL, pinned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pin_order INTEGER, section_id INTEGER, muted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, snoozed_until TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (person_id, kind, item_id) )

table inbox_sections: CREATE TABLE inbox_sections ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, person_id TEXT NOT NULL, zone TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (zone IN ('bots', 'orb')), name TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL )
table message_reads: CREATE TABLE message_reads ( message_id INTEGER NOT NULL, agent TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (message_id, agent) )

table messages: CREATE TABLE messages ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, from_agent TEXT NOT NULL, to_agent TEXT NOT NULL, task_id INTEGER, body TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL , from_task INTEGER)
table projects: CREATE TABLE projects ( name TEXT PRIMARY KEY COLLATE NOCASE, path TEXT NOT NULL, notes TEXT DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL , grupo TEXT)

table schedules: CREATE TABLE schedules ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, project TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, agent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'any', model TEXT, readonly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, every TEXT NOT NULL, at_time TEXT, weekdays TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, approved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_run TEXT, last_run TEXT, last_task INTEGER, created_at TEXT NOT NULL , same_chat INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, conversation_id INTEGER)
table session_items: CREATE TABLE session_items ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL )

table session_queue: CREATE TABLE session_queue ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, images TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table sessions: CREATE TABLE sessions ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('chat', 'task')), agent TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT, reasoning TEXT, permission TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'editar', project TEXT, cwd TEXT NOT NULL, task_id INTEGER, account TEXT, title TEXT NOT NULL, cli_session TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle', archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL , titled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, context TEXT, settled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, parent_id TEXT, android INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
table settings: CREATE TABLE settings ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL )
table sqlite_sequence: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

table tasks: CREATE TABLE tasks ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, project TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, agent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'any', model TEXT, reasoning TEXT CHECK (reasoning IN ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh')), fast INTEGER CHECK (fast IN (0, 1)), launch TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, depends_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', sensitivity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', status TEXT NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT, approval_hash TEXT, approval_sig TEXT, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, assigned_to TEXT, branch TEXT, workdir TEXT, project_path TEXT, mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'carpeta', readonly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pid INTEGER, session_id TEXT, account TEXT, run_account TEXT, result TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL , parent_id INTEGER, limited_until TEXT, review_of INTEGER, schedule_id INTEGER, level TEXT, conversation_id INTEGER, claimed_session TEXT)

table usage_ledger: CREATE TABLE usage_ledger ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, at TEXT, day TEXT, person_id TEXT, account_id TEXT, bot_id INTEGER, conversation_id INTEGER, session_id TEXT, task_id INTEGER, turns INTEGER, tokens_in INTEGER, tokens_out INTEGER, usd REAL )
